title: Alphabet could be in for a tough period ahead, analysts warn
text: Alphabet shares fell about 5% as the company reported lower-than-expected YouTube advertising revenue . Alphabet highlighted plans to boost capital expenditures as it races to meet rising AI demand . Wall Street is preparing for some choppiness in the near term . CEO Sundar Pichai noted during an earnings call that "the risk of underinvesting is dramatically greater than overinvesting"

title: Facebook is opening its first showroom to sell VR headsets
text: The Meta Store will open on May 9 at the company's Burlingame, California, campus . The store will have demo areas where people can try Oculus virtual reality headsets . The company has devoted $10 billion over the next year to build the "metaverse" Mark Zuckerberg believes it will become the standard for working, socializing and gaming .

title: Amazon CEO Jassy says company is reducing bureaucracy, which is ‘anathema’ to innovation
text: Amazon CEO Jassy says company is reducing bureaucracy, which is 'anathema' to innovation . Jassy has been on a campaign to slash costs across the company in recent years . Amazon has laid off more than 27,000 employees since 2022, and axed some of its more unprofitable initiatives .

title: Abbott Laboratories CEO calls post-earnings stock decline 'a little bit of an overreaction'
text: Abbott Laboratories CEO calls post-earnings stock decline 'a little bit of an overreaction' Abbott posted a top and bottom line beat for the second quarter . Investors were disappointed that the company tightened its full-year earnings guidance . Abbott is known for a variety of products and services in the healthcare field .

title: Nvidia and Jackson Hole are the big catalysts this week. How stocks could react
text: Nvidia is set to report fiscal second-quarter results Wednesday after the bell . Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh will deliver a speech at the Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium on Friday . Nvidia has been the stalwart for the artificial intelligence trade that has catapulted the broader market to all-time highs .

title: Apple CEO Tim Cook explains why people might want a mixed reality headset
text: Tim Cook explains why people might want a virtual reality headset . Apple CEO Tim Cook says mixed reality could "greatly enhance people's communication, people's connection" Cook didn't confirm or deny the existence of the headset, but he said it could be used in art, communication, and corporate environments .

title: Deutsche Bank upgrades Southwest Airlines, sees more upside following Elliott-inspired shakeup
text: Deutsche Bank upgrades Southwest Airlines, sees more upside following Elliott-inspired shakeup . Analyst Michael Linenberg upgraded the airline stock to buy from hold and increased his price target by 43% to $40 from $28 . The upgrade comes after Elliott and Southwest Airlines struck a deal in October to keep chief executive Bob Jordan and add six directors to the airline's board .

title: U.S. approves Verizon deal to acquire Frontier after DEI changes
text: FCC approves Verizon deal to acquire Frontier after diversity, equity and inclusion changes . Verizon agreed to buy Frontier in September for about $9.6 billion and absorb $10 billion in Frontier debt . FCC chair Brendan Carr said he was opening a probe of Verizon for its promotion of DEI programs and said it could be a factor in the Frontier deal .

title: Microsoft closes at record after revealing pricing for new A.I. subscription
text: Microsoft announced pricing for its new Microsoft 365 artificial intelligence subscription service . The company's Copilot subscription service adds AI to its Office products such as Word, Excel and Teams . It will cost an additional $30 per month and could increase monthly prices for enterprise customers as much as 83% . The announcement shows how Microsoft is continuing to build on its suite of Office software .

title: 3 tips for writing an effective resume summary, says ex-Nvidia recruiter: 'Leave out the years of experience'
text: Stefanie Fackrell is a former Google and Nvidia recruiter and current HR consultant . She says to avoid "bias or ageism," she says, leave out the years of experience on your resume . Include a line at the top about what kind of work scenario you're looking for -- remote, hybrid, on-site .

title: More than 40% of labor force to be affected by AI in 3 years, Morgan Stanley forecasts
text: More than 40% of labor force to be affected by AI in 3 years, Morgan Stanley forecasts . Analyst Brian Nowak estimates the AI technology will have a $4.1 trillion economic effect on the labor force . Morgan Stanley sees some positive tailwinds for software companies as a result of AI adoption .

title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang sells more than $36 million in stock, catching up with Warren Buffett in net worth
text: Huang's net worth has grown by more than a quarter, or about $29 billion, since the start of 2025 . Huang still holds more than 858 million shares of Nvidia, both directly and indirectly, in different partnerships and trusts . On Wednesday, Nvidia became the first company to top a $4 trillion market capitalization, surpassing Microsoft and Apple .

title: San Jose bakery loses thousands of dollars after Tesla reportedly cancels large order
text: The Giving Pies in San Jose lost thousands of dollars after Tesla reportedly cancels large order . Owner Voahangy Rasetarinera says she's done similar big jobs in the past with no trouble . NBC Bay Area reached out to Tesla to ask about what went wrong with the catering deal and whether or not the company will compensate the bakery .

title: WTW to Announce Fourth Quarter and Full Year Earnings on February 3, 2026
text: Title-WTW to Announce Fourth Quarter and Full Year Earnings on February 3, 2026 . Company will host a conference call to discuss its financial results at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time on Tuesday, February 3 . A live, listen-only webcast of the conference call will be available on WTW's website .

title: Pfizer stops enrollment in Covid antiviral trial in standard-risk population
text: Title-Pfizer stops enrollment in Covid antiviral trial in standard-risk population . Drug has emergency use authorization for high-risk groups in which it has been effective in reducing hospitalizations and deaths . New data showed a 51% relative risk reduction in standard risk groups, company says .

title: NTAP & NVDA Power Agentic AI With Intelligent Data Infrastructure
text: The initiative focuses on the NVIDIA AI Data Platform reference design, which enables businesses to harness their data more effectively for AI-driven reasoning and inference . By integrating NetApp ONTAP with NVIDIA's AI computing and software ecosystem, enterprises can unlock the full value of their data and drive AI-powered decision-making .

title: Russia tried to influence U.S. elections in 2022 and will do it again, nation's top intel agency says
text: The Office of the Director of National Intelligence releases its annual assessment of worldwide threats to U.S. national security . Russia is using increasingly clandestine means to "penetrate the Western information environment," the report says . Moscow will also work to "strengthen ties" to Americans in media and politics as it works to carry out "future influence operations"

title: Nvidia slides 13% in three days after briefly becoming most valuable company
text: Nvidia has dropped for three consecutive trading days and is now down 13% from its peak . Monday's slide was the chipmaker's second steepest drop of the year . Nvidia's decline brought with it a slide in chipmakers and other tech companies tied to the artificial intelligence boom . Last week, Nvidia briefly became the world's most valuable company .

title: From Nvidia earnings to trade war tape bombs, a simple strategy could be this week's best bet
text: Nvidia earnings could be the one that reignites the fire after a year of ho-hum post-earnings price action . The September 8 Canadian retaliation date, and the Treasury's entire buyback window beginning September 9, are all potential catalysts . If the market extends the gains, one can participate, and if it doesn't? Little has been risked .

title: Bank of America upgrades First Solar, says Street is underappreciating climate bill benefits
text: Analyst Julien Dumoulin-Smith upgraded shares of the solar stock to a buy rating and raised his price target to $141 a share . Shares of First Solar have skyrocketed nearly 40% this year and 22.7% since the start of August . The Inflation Reduction Act was signed into law earlier this month .

title: Micron (MU) May Get More Than $6B to Set Up Factories in the US
text: Micron Technology Inc. poised to receive a substantial boost with reports indicating that it could secure more than $6 billion in chip grants for establishing factories in the United States . The award, which isn't yet finalized, will be given under the U.S. government's 2022 Chips and Science Act, which provides funds to chip manufacturers for domestic production .

title: Ark Invest's Cathie Wood buys Coinbase shares for a second straight day
text: Cathie Wood bought 102,281 shares of the crypto exchange for her flagship ARK Innovation ETF . Wood also bought 139,105 shares of Coinbase for the Innovation ETF on Friday . The back-to-back buys came amid a flurry of aggressive regulatory actions from U.S. authorities . The New York State Department of Financial Services told Paxos to stop minting new Binance coins .

title: FDA approves Bristol Myers Squibb's schizophrenia drug, the first new type of treatment in decades
text: Cobenfy is the first novel type of treatment for schizophrenia in more than seven decades . The twice-daily pill will cost $1,850 for a month's supply or $22,500 annually before insurance . Cobenfe met the main goal of three clinical trials, significantly decreasing symptoms of schizophrenia compared with a placebo . The drug's price could limit use of the drug to patients who have already tried and failed with existing treatments .

title: Corona beer maker Constellation Brands takes action aimed at enhancing shareholder value and stock pops
text: Corona and Modelo beer maker Constellation Brands takes action aimed at enhancing shareholder value and stock pops . Company made two new additions to its board of directors . Company has entered into an information sharing and cooperation agreement with activist investor Elliott Management . Elliott was recently involved in a multi-activist situation at Club name Salesforce .

title: Microsoft shares sink more than 7% on weak guidance, but analysts bullish on rebound
text: Microsoft shares close down more than 7% on weak guidance, but analysts bullish on rebound . Microsoft surpassed expectations on the top and bottom lines, but the stock was pressured by weak guidance and cloud revenue . Goldman Sachs analysts are not discouraged by the weaker, cyclical segments, and reiterated their buy rating on the stock .

title: JPMorgan advising First Republic on strategic alternatives, including a capital raise, sources say
text: JPMorgan and other banks are working with others in the industry on a solution for the bank . JPMorgan and 10 other banks announced last week that they were depositing a combined $30 billion in First Republic . First Republic shares dropped 47% in a volatile session, extending a dramatic decline in March . The bank's stock is now down 90% month to date .

title: SEC investigating Illumina over acquisition of cancer test developer Grail
text: The SEC is investigating Illumina over its controversial $7.1 billion acquisition of cancer test developer Grail . The DNA sequencing company says it is cooperating with the SEC . The European Commission fined Illumina $476 million last month for closing the acquisition without first securing regulatory approval . The company's market value has fallen to roughly $28 billion from about $75 billion the month the deal closed .

title: Google to invest record $15 billion in AI infrastructure in the 'Texas of Europe'
text: Google to invest record $15 billion in AI infrastructure in Finland, marking largest single investment in Europe . Finland has emerged as a key location for data centers amid the AI boom, with hyperscalers and developers eyeing its available land and power . Google will deploy the capital through 2028, including into data centers and other supporting investments like energy projects .

title: CNBC Daily Open: Nvidia aims to have its 'five layer cake' of AI and eat it too
text: Nvidia aims to have its 'five layer cake' of AI and eat it too . CEO Jensen Huang: "Agentic AI has arrived. Demand has gone parabolic" U.K. unveils "historic" trade deal with Gulf states that marks first such agreement among G7 nations . SpaceX set to be first in a hat-trick of mega IPOs this year .

title: Equifax Q2 Review: Not Much Excitement Going Forward
text: Management aims to double AI-driven cost reductions to $150M over two years, targeting operational efficiency and margin improvement . I maintain a hold stance, citing weak guidance, persistent negative sentiment, and a still-rich 21x forward P/E despite a 35% share price decline .

title: TRV Rallies 14.7% YTD, Trades at Premium: Should You Buy the Stock?
text: Title-TRV Rallies 14.7% YTD, Trades at Premium: Should You Buy the Stock? Body-Shares of The Travelers Companies, Inc. TRV are trading at a premium compared with the Zacks Insurance - Property and Casualty industry .

title: Geopolitical tensions with the U.S. could 'supercharge' China's innovation, JPMorgan says
text: U.S.-China tensions have pushed Beijing to be more self-sufficient, an investment specialist at JPMorgan Asset Management says . Alexander Treves: "Geopolitics are here to stay, so get used to it, just accept that" Treves said investors should look for companies that will succeed in spite of geopolitical tensions .

title: Ireland now needs to decide what it will do with 13 billion euros in back taxes from Apple
text: European Court of Justice rules that Apple must pay Ireland billions of euros in back taxes . Ruling means Ireland will receive 13 billion euros ($14.4 billion) in unpaid taxes from Apple . Decision welcomed by tax justice advocates as well as outgoing competition chief Margrethe Vestager .

title: This oil tanker stock has outperformed. Bank of America sees more gains, even if U.S.-Iran war ends
text: Bank of America upgraded Scorpio Tankers to buy from underperform . It raised its price target on shares to $100 from $76, implying 21% upside from Wednesday's close . Since the start of the conflict in late February, the firm has booked more business due to increased ton mile demand .

title: We're updating our rating on recently spun FedEx Freight after a strong run-up
text: Stocks are pulling back again as investors take profits in technology and AI infrastructure stocks that had become stretched after their recent run . FedEx announced late Monday that its board had approved a 5% increase to its annual dividend . Casey's General Stores and Cracker Barrel report after the closing bell, and Chewy reports before the opening bell on Wednesday .

title: Analysts see big upside for Coinbase: 'Fast becoming the AWS of Crypto financial infrastructure'
text: Analysts see big upside for Coinbase: 'Fast becoming the AWS of Crypto financial infrastructure' The company's stock rose 9% on Friday, just one day after it posted revenue of $1.87 billion for the third quarter . The firm's topline grew as it partnered with financial giants like J.P. Morgan and PNC .

text: The full transcript of the full earnings call transcript is available below . Headline of the transcript is: "DoorDash Inc (NASDAQ:DASH) Q1 2024 Earnings Call Transcript Highlights: Strategic Expansions and ... more importantly, the company has seen positive unit economics in new verticals .

title: Barclays downgrades Nike heading into earnings next week, cites slew of challenges for apparel maker
text: Title-Barclays downgrades shares of Nike heading into earnings next week . Analyst Adrienne Yih downgraded shares to equal weight from overweight . Yih cites slew of challenges for apparel maker . Shares of Nike are down 36% this year, and roughly 40% off their 52-week high .

title: Elon Musk bids farewell — sort of — to Trump Cabinet, claims DOGE saved $160 billion
text: Tesla CEO Elon Musk says his DOGE program has "saved" $160 billion so far, far less than his original projections . Musk: "A tremendous amount has been accomplished in the first 100 days" Trump: "We all want to thank you for your help. You've been treated very unfairly"

title: CVS tops estimates, hikes guidance as insurance business shows some improvement
text: CVS says it is "maintaining a cautious view for the remainder of the year" CEO David Joyner says the company is watching for the potential impact from President Trump's planned tariffs on pharmaceuticals imported into the U.S. Joyner succeeded Karen Lynch in mid-October, as CVS struggled to drive higher profits .

title: Nvidia is trying to quiet 'circular financing' accusations. Wall Street is unsure it will
text: Nvidia announced "memorandums of understanding" with six financial heavyweights on Monday . The MOUs are designed to provide half-a-trillion dollars of financing for Nvidia customers to purchase the company's products . Some analysts on Wall Street are skeptical of Nvidia's latest financing initiative .

title: Tesla shares slide after Q3 revenue miss, Bernstein says earnings call 'didn't sit well with us'
text: Tesla shares slide after Q3 revenue miss, Bernstein says earnings call 'didn't sit well with us' Shares of Tesla slid about 6.7% Thursday as investors digested the company's third-quarter earnings report . Tesla reported earnings of $1.05 per share, beating expectations of 99 cents a share .

title: Microsoft's GitHub is relying more on Azure, says cloud chief
text: Microsoft has been making its GitHub subsidiary more dependent on the company's own Azure cloud . That lines up with Microsoft's desire to increase the use of Azure, whose revenue was growing 40% in the second quarter . Microsoft must be careful not to break commitments it made at the time of the $7.5 billion GitHub acquisition .

title: Elon Musk confirms Tesla plan for robotaxis on Austin roads in June
text: Tesla CEO Elon Musk confirms Tesla plan for robotaxis on Austin roads in June . Musk said a Tesla robotaxi service will start with about 10 vehicles in Austin, Texas, and rapidly expand to thousands of vehicles should the launch go well with no incidents . Musk: "It's prudent for us to start with a small number, confirm that things are going well and then scale it up"

title: Sam Altman's Reddit stake worth over $600 million after first day pop on NYSE
text: Sam Altman's Reddit stake worth over $600 million after first day pop on NYSE . Altman, 38, is among the biggest Reddit shareholders, with control of 7.6% of outstanding shares after the offering . He is restricted from selling Reddit shares for six months during the so-called lockup period .

title: These 10 jobs are the least AI-safe, according to new Microsoft report: 5 are in customer service
text: Microsoft analyzed 200,000 anonymous and privacy-scrubbed conversations with AI chatbot Bing Copilot and U.S. users . Microsoft found that many desk jobs are at risk of being upended, as AI can complete a significant amount of their work duties . The report also named the occupations that were the most AI proof, largely consisting of medical and blue-collar jobs, typically requiring more physical or hands-on work .

title: AirPods-maker Luxshare sees shares close lower in tepid Hong Kong debut
text: Apple supplier Luxshare Precision Industry sees shares close lower in tepid Hong Kong debut . Apple supplier's multi-billion-dollar IPO is largest this year in Hong Kong . Luxshare has evolved into supplier of parts for electronics and communications products . Apple accounts for approximately 70% of Luxshare's revenue, according to PitchBook .

title: Family's abandoned train car turned Airbnb brings in up to $110,000 a year: 'Our dreams were surpassed'
text: Isaac French, 27, and his family purchased a train car that had been sitting abandoned on a neighbor's farm in Deary, Idaho . The family took out a $150,000 loan, including $3,000 to purchase the train car . French: "There are a lot of opportunities right under people that they don't even realize because they've always been there"

title: FDA advisors recommend full approval of Pfizer Covid treatment Paxlovid for adults 50 and over and other high-risk people
text: FDA panel of advisors recommends full approval of Pfizer's Covid-19 antiviral pill Paxlovid for high-risk adults . Drug is advised for people over 50 or those with medical conditions that place them at a higher risk of ending up in the hospital or dying from Covid . The FDA is slated to make a final decision in May .

title: Moderna stock plunges nearly 17% after company lowers 2025 sales forecast by $1 billion
text: Title-Moderna stock plunges nearly 17% after company lowers 2025 sales forecast by $1 billion . Most of those sales will come from Moderna's Covid shot and newly launched RSV shot . CFO Jamey Mock: "As we head into 2025, there are a handful of uncertainties that we are planning for"

title: A lesser known area of the AI market is set for its biggest boom since 2022. Buy this stock to play the trend, Morgan Stanley says
text: Morgan Stanley upgraded software cybersecurity name Dynatrace to overweight from equal weight . Analyst Sanjit Singh says observability, a subset of the AI market, is poised for its biggest boom in roughly four years . The bank's call falls in line with consensus on Wall Street . Shares have risen 13% year to date .

title: ConocoPhillips says it will cut workforce by 20-25%, shares fall
text: U.S. oil and gas producer ConocoPhillips says it will cut workforce by 20-25%, shares fall 4.5% to $94.55, outpacing a 2.6% drop in the broader S&P 500 Energy Index . The company has about 13,000 employees globally, meaning between 2,600 and 3,250 employees will be affected .

title: Warren Buffett says Greg Abel will make Berkshire Hathaway investing decisions when he's gone
text: Buffett says Greg Abel will have the final say on Berkshire Hathaway's investing decisions when he's gone . Abel, 61, became known as Buffett's heir apparent in 2021 after Charlie Munger inadvertently made the revelation at the shareholder meeting . Abel has been overseeing a major portion of Berkshire's sprawling empire, including energy, railroad and retail . Buffett: "We do not want to try and have 200 people around that are managing a billion each"

title: Citigroup tops profit estimates as bank benefits from rising interest rates, shares surge 13%
text: Citigroup shares surged 13% in New York trading, the bank's biggest post-earnings stock gain in more than two decades . Net interest income jumped 14% to $11.96 billion, topping Wall Street analysts' estimates . Citigroup also announced it is pausing share buybacks after the Federal Reserve stress test .

title: Goldman Sachs expects 'all time high' oil demand to spur large deficits, boosting prices
text: Goldman Sachs expects 'all time high' oil demand to spur large deficits, boosting prices . Head of oil research Daan Struyven says demand will reach an all-time high in the third quarter . U.S. oil rig count recently hit its lowest level in 16 months, down 15% from its late 2022 peak .

title: Watch a young Bill Gates discuss Microsoft and Apple's rises in a 1994 employee orientation video
text: Bill Gates recaps Microsoft's founding story and some of its signature moments in a 1994 employee orientation video . At the time, Gates was still CEO of Microsoft, and he was worth an estimated $9.35 billion, according to Forbes . The video was restored and uploaded to YouTube by the Computer History Archives Project in November . In the video, Gates praises Apple's "graphical interface" and Microsoft Word .

title: Apple is getting punished for the one thing it did not deliver this quarter
text: Revenue in Apple's fiscal 2025 second quarter rose 5% year over year to $95.4 billion . Earnings per share increased by 8% in the quarter to $1.65 versus the $94.7 billion estimated by LSEG . Services sales did grow 11.6% to $26.65 billion . Apple ended the March quarter with $133 billion in cash and marketable securities .

title: T. Rowe Price (TROW) Q3 Earnings Surpass Estimates
text: T. Rowe Price (TROW) came out with quarterly earnings of $2.57 per share, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate . This quarterly report represents an earnings surprise of 8.90% . Over the last four quarters, the company has surpassed consensus EPS estimates four times . The company has added about 2% since the beginning of the year versus the S&P 500's gain of 19.6%.

title: Nvidia faces Wall Street's high expectations two years into AI boom
text: Nvidia is expected to report a year-over-year jump of 53% to $45.9 billion in its second-quarter report . The chipmaker will pay 15% of its China chip revenue to the U.S. government in exchange for licenses to export its China-focused AI chip .

title: Zoetis Inc. (ZTS) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
text: Title-Zoetis Inc. (ZTS) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript: Company's Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Conference Call and Webcast . Hosting the call today is Steve Frank, Vice President of Investor Relations for Zoetis. Hosting today is Kristin Peck, CEO & Director; Wetteny Joseph, CFO .

title: Boeing's crewed Starliner flight won't return until at least August, NASA says
text: Title-Boeing's crewed Starliner flight won't return until at least August, NASA says . The spacecraft has been docked with the International Space Station for 50 days and counting . NASA and Boeing are still studying problems that arose early in the flight . Officials previously said that Starliner is safe to return in the event of an emergency .

title: AbbVie bets $10.9 billion on Apogee in next-generation immunology growth push
text: AbbVie will buy Apogee Therapeutics for $10.9 billion in its largest buyout in more than five years . The deal is one of the largest biotech deals of the year . It underscores the surge in pharmaceutical dealmaking, as companies race to build their portfolios ahead of looming patent expirations on blockbuster treatments .

title: Arizona is the first state to support digital driver's licenses in Apple Wallet on iPhone
text: Arizona is the first state to support digital driver's licenses in Apple Wallet on iPhone . Users will be asked to take a selfie and scan their plastic driver's license . Apple also plans to introduce the feature in Colorado, Hawaii, Mississippi, Ohio, and Puerto Rico in addition to seven states previously announced .

title: CME Group Declares Annual Variable Dividend and Q1 2026 Quarterly Dividend
text: CME Group announces its annual variable dividend and first-quarter regular dividend, both of which are payable March 26, 2026 . Annual variable dividend based on 2025 financial results of $6.15 per share totals approximately $2.2 billion . First quarter regular dividend of $1.30 per share is a 5 cent increase from the prior level . CME is the world's leading derivatives marketplace .

title: U.S. proposes $270,000 fine at joint venture GM battery plant after OSHA explosion investigation
text: U.S. investigators propose $270,000 fine at joint venture GM battery plant after OSHA explosion investigation . OSHA issues 19 safety and health violations, 17 of them serious . Ultium Cells says it has taken safety seriously and requested a hearing with OSHA .

title: Marvell shares are down after earnings. Many analysts are still bullish
text: Semiconductor maker Marvell posted $2.74 billion in revenue for the second quarter . Analysts at five banks reiterated buy or buy-equivalent ratings on the stock . Marvell stock has soared 184% this year . Morgan Stanley's Joseph Moore said he would be "tactically long" for the analyst day in October .

title: GM halts production at two major U.S. plants due to Hurricane Helene
text: GM cancels shifts Thursday and Friday at Flint, Michigan, Flint, Texas, Arlington, Texas plants . Automaker says it's working with suppliers to "minimize impacts" on plants . GM declines to disclose what suppliers are impacted or where they are located . Hurricane Helene made landfall in Florida late last week and hit the southeastern United States .

title: Jim Cramer urges investors to 'steer clear' of Intel despite its turnaround plans
text: Cramer: "You want to steer clear of this" Intel's stock has fallen about 30% over the past five years . Analyst Stacy Rasgon has a hold rating and $42-per-share price target on Intel . Intel's chip manufacturing business recorded an operating loss of $7 billion in 2023, Rasgon says .

title: Uber reports surging revenue as drivers return, but posts massive loss on investments
text: Uber's revenue rose 136% year over year to $6.85 billion in the first quarter . The ride-hailing company said it wouldn't have to put up "significant" investments to keep drivers on the platform . But it also reported a $5.9 billion loss during the period that was largely attributed to the revaluation of equity investments .

title: ADP payrolls report could be providing a warning about the weakening labor market
text: Title-ADP's private payrolls report for May painted a pretty dour picture of the labor market . How much that will be mirrored in Friday's official nonfarm payrolls tally, though, is anybody's guess . The report found that businesses with fewer than 50 employees reported a loss of 13,000 .

title: Netflix earnings: CEO Reed Hastings steps down, COO Greg Peters to take co-CEO role
text: Netflix CEO Reed Hastings steps down, COO Greg Peters to take co-CEO role . Hastings will now serve as the company's executive chairman . Netflix also reported fourth quarter results that were mixed, with subscriber growth topping expectations . Netflix stock was up as much as 6% following this news .

title: Alphabet shares dip to start the week. Here's what the experts have to say
text: Samsung is considering a switch from Google to Microsoft's Bing as its default search engine on its devices . Morgan Stanley reiterated Alphabet as overweight and remained bullish on the stock heading into earnings next week . Google is currently held in Jim Cramer's Charitable Trust portfolio . The action follows a report in The New York Times .

title: Investors are questioning gold’s role in portfolios, says Morgan Stanley — but another metal is set to outperform
text: Gold's conventional role as a portfolio risk management tool has been brought into question following a dramatic six-week period for commodity prices . Morgan Stanley's Amy Gower, metals and mining strategist at Morgan Stanley, says another metal is set to outperform gold . The value of the precious yellow metal plummeted alongside most global asset classes at the outbreak of the Iran conflict .

title: U.S. intel on China considering lethal aid for Putin's war was gleaned from Russian officials
text: Title-U.S. officials spent weeks corroborating the information from other sources of intelligence . "That's not going to be good for the people of Ukraine," a senior administration official said . "A Russian military that's fueled by or aided by a Chinese infusion of weapons and platforms is more . and more capable"

title: Visa debuts a new product designed to make it safer to pay directly from your bank account
text: Visa plans to launch a dedicated service for account-to-account (A2A) payments in Europe next year . Users will be able to set up direct debits on merchants' e-commerce stores with just a few clicks . The product will initially launch in the U.K. in early 2025, with subsequent releases in Europe later in 2025 .

title: Hedge funds bought into these outperforming industrial stocks, including Lockheed Martin
text: RBC analyzed stock-level holdings of 310 hedge funds based on regulatory filings . Hedge funds' overweight to the industrial sector hit a new high at the end of the first quarter . RBC screened S & P 500 for names with most new positions added by hedge funds . Three of the top six names on the list turned out to be industrials .

title: Amazon to conduct racial-equity audit led by former Attorney General Loretta Lynch
text: Amazon to conduct racial-equity audit of its hourly workers . Audit will be conducted by former U.S. Attorney General Loretta Lynch . Shareholders have been pressing for an independent review of how the company's policies contribute to racial inequities . Amazon has urged shareholders to vote down the proposal .

title: WTW appoints My Thien Nguyen as Country Leader and Head of Corporate Risk & Broking in Vietnam
text: WTW appoints My Thien Nguyen as Country Leader and Head of Corporate Risk & Broking in Vietnam, effective 1 August 2023 . Thien succeeds Philippe Robineau who will leave WTW on 31 July . WTW is a leading global advisory, broking and solutions company .

title: Apple or Samsung? Tech investor Paul Meeks reveals which tech giant he'd buy
text: Top tech investor Paul Meeks advises investors to stay away for now . Meeks prefers Apple for its relative safety in the short term . He believes Samsung will be "badly impacted," as it derives nearly third of its revenues from its memory chip business . Over the longer term, Meeks believes Samsung is the better bet .

title: There are still four Wall Street bears left on Nvidia. Here’s what they are saying about results
text: Nvidia's data center revenue came up short of expectations for the second quarter in a row . The graphics processing unit manufacturer posted second-quarter adjusted earnings of $1.05 per share . The last quarter also marked Nvidia's slowest period of growth since mid-2023 . Seaport Research Partners, D.A. Davidson, Deutsche Bank and HSBC were cautious .

text: GE HealthCare Technologies Inc. (NASDAQ:GEHC) Q3 2023 Earnings Call Transcript . At this time of the call, all participants are in a listen-only mode . This call will include both GAAP and non-GAAP financial results . As a reminder, this call is being recorded .

title: Goldman Sachs says this little-known biotech stock can jump more than 50%
text: Goldman Sachs says Ventyx Biosciences has a promising new oral treatment in development for plaque psoriasis . The analyst's 12-month price target of $50 implies upside of roughly 53% from Friday's closing price for the stock . The TYK2 inhibitor is expected to have "one of the cleanest safety profiles" among its competitors .

text: Title-CRH (CRH) Raises 2025 Earnings Guidance amid 6% Dividend Increase . Board declared a 6% increase in quarterly dividends . CRH's stock price increased by 3.9% in the last quarter, the broader market experienced a 22% gain over the past year .
